adds.title: Human Dignity Trust
adds.summary: UAE federal law criminalises trans gender expression under Article 412 of the Federal Crimes and Penalties Law issued September 2021 and effective January 2022, punishing a man disguising as a woman to enter a women-only space with up to one year imprisonment and a fine up to 10,000 dirhams, replacing the broader 1987 Federal Penal Code Article 359 male-in-female-apparel offence; transgender and gender non-conforming people are regularly arrested on dress and behaviour grounds with airport questioning and detention of trans visitors, including detention and questioning of trans blogger Gigi Gorgeous in 2016, detention in August 2017 of two Singaporeans including a trans woman convicted and sentenced to one year for attempting to resemble women then deported 28 August 2017 after nearly three weeks in custody including in a cell for effeminate people with alleged forced anal examinations, 2020 arrests and deportations of foreign residents for clothing deemed inappropriate for one's sex, March/July/December 2012 arrests for disguising as a woman, a June 2011 Dubai police campaign targeting transsexuals and boyat, and May 2025 detention in Dubai of Armenian trans defender Lilit Martirosyan while transiting who was told she could not enter as a transgender person before being allowed to leave.
